KEY ECONOMICS (value = flow x price x 28.8e6 $/yr per mol/s):
- C6 paraffin mix (2,2DMB+2MP+3MP+nC6=970 mol/s) @0.85*0.0423 = $1182M/yr. Biggest prize but C6 paraffins vs C6 naphthenes gap is only 3.1K (nC6 341.9 vs MCP 345.0) -> infeasible cheaply.
- C5 mix (iC5+nC5=695 mol/s) @0.85*0.03635 = $618M/yr. Gap nC5 309.2 -> 2,2DMB 322.9 = 13.7K (moderate).
- C6 naphthene mix (MCP+CyC6=269) $396M/yr; C4 mix (iC4+nC4=544) $186M/yr; C3 mix $73M/yr.
Column cost brutal: 45-stage ~$343M/yr, 55-stage ~$292M/yr. So 2 columns ~$600M/yr -> need >$600M/yr revenue.

BIG BP GAPS (easy cuts): C4/C5 = 28K, C5/C6-paraffin: nC5 309.2 -> 2,2DMB 322.9 = 13.7K, CyC6 353.9 -> nC7 371.6 = 17.7K.

FAILURE MODE from probes: cuts straddle 95% threshold; need cut exactly on a large gap + enough stages.

FINAL ATTEMPT: column 1 (60/8/8) cuts lights (C3+C4) overhead from C5+ bottoms; column 2 (60/8/8) on that tops... no, on bottoms (C5+) splitting C5 mix overhead from C6+ bottoms. Two columns, aim revenue ~$618M+$186M >~$600M cost. Marginal but the only shot. Empty plant remains best if this fails.
